# Sawa

> Sawa is an email revenue partner for creators, influencers, and founder-led brands. Sawa builds and runs end-to-end email systems that help creators grow their list, run newsletters, and launch products — turning email into a reliable revenue channel.

## What Sawa is
Sawa is a done-for-you email revenue partner. Rather than an agency that hands off tasks, Sawa owns the whole email channel end-to-end: strategy, list growth, newsletter production, product launches, automation, copy, and revenue optimization. The creator creates; Sawa handles the inbox.

## Who it serves
- Creators and influencers with an engaged audience
- Founder-led brands
- Anyone who wants to turn an existing audience into recurring email revenue

## What it does
- Grows your email list
- Runs your newsletter every week
- Plans and executes product launches over email
- Builds and maintains lifecycle automation
- Optimizes email for revenue

## Core services
- End-to-end email marketing systems — the full system, built and run for you
- List growth
- Weekly newsletter production
- Product launch campaigns
- Email automation and lifecycle flows
- Copywriting and revenue optimization
